section: 1/1/2024Enacted by Chapter 464, 2023 General Session2023Definitions.As used in this chapter: "Charging station" means equipment designed to deliver electric energy to an electric vehicle for a fee. "Charging station operator" means a person who owns or operates a charging station in the state. "Charging station subscription" means a service for which a person pays a charging station operator a subscription fee for a reduced charging rate or unlimited charging during the subscription period. "Electric vehicle" means a qualifying electric vehicle or qualifying plug-in hybrid vehicle. "Qualifying electric vehicle" means the same as that term is defined in Section 11-42a-102. "Qualifying plug-in hybrid vehicle" means the same as that term is defined in Section 11-42a-102.
